description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka- Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010 Checklist of the Implementing Standerds as at 30.06.2025
reasoning: This gazette content involves the issuance of implementing standards under the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010, which constitutes regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
